spec.name: Calder Hanging Mobile
spec.description: An Alexander Calder-style hanging mobile: a cascade of four black wire balance arms stepping down from a ceiling anchor, each tipped and weighted with hand-cut flat sheet-metal lobes in red, yellow, blue and white on black.
spec.layout: The whole model hangs in mid-air; nothing touches the floor (the lowest shape bottom sits at y ≈ 0.82, the ceiling anchor plate at y = 2.40). From the front (+Z) it reads as a Calder cascade: a small white ceiling plate at the top, a vertical black drop rod, then four thin black wire arms zig-zagging down and outward — arm1 runs along X (left tip high at x −0.88, right tip low at x 0.47), arm2 runs front-to-back along Z (front tip high, back tip low), arm3 runs along X again (left tip −0.38, right tip 0.87), and a final thin dangler of three stacked flat shapes hangs at x 0.87 down to y 0.82. Each arm balances like a real mobile: heavy flat lobes hang on short wires from one tip while the drop wire to the next arm hangs from the other. All sheet shapes are thin (10–14 mm) hand-cut organic outlines — leaves, petals, ovals, discs and blades — built as extrusions with visible facet edges, in Calder primaries; the wires and arms are near-black steel rods. The style shows in the balanced asymmetry, the hard flat colour sheets against black wire, and the hand-drawn irregular silhouettes of every lobe.

parts.builds: The top of the mobile. A small white ceiling plate: a flat disc (r 0.07, thickness 0.012) against the ceilingAnchor mount. A vertical black drop rod (r 0.012) runs from ceilingAnchor straight down to pivot1. The first balance arm is a black rod (r 0.011) from left tip [-0.88, 2.23, 0.15] (higher) to right tip [0.47, 2.12, 0.15] (lower), pivoting at pivot1. At the left tip two short wires (r 0.008) hang two flat hand-cut lobes: a red leaf (~0.20 tall × 0.12 wide, thickness 0.012, centred [-0.88, 2.05, 0.15]) and a white oval (~0.13 × 0.09, centred [-0.86, 1.99, 0.22]) on a slightly shorter wire so they stagger. Mid-beam at [-0.43, 2.20, 0.15] a red leaf (~0.18 × 0.10, thickness 0.012) sits directly on the rod like a small flag. From the right tip the black drop rod continues straight down to pivot2, where it hands off to the midTier beam. Build every lobe with b.extrude (organic 5–7 point outline, slight bevel, thickness ~0.012) so the hand-cut facet edges show; wires are thin cylinders or b.rod/capsule in the wire colour.
parts.attaches: Ceiling plate at mount ceilingAnchor; arm1 pivots at joint hanger/pivot1 via joint arm1; its drop rod ends exactly at mount pivot2 where midTier's beam hangs.

parts.builds: The second balance arm, hanging from pivot2. A black rod (r 0.011) runs front-to-back along Z from front tip [0.47, 1.90, 0.58] (higher) to back tip [0.47, 1.79, -0.48] (lower). From mid-beam at [0.47, 1.88, 0.35] a wire (r 0.008) drops to a blue leaf (~0.22 tall × 0.14 wide, thickness 0.012, centred [0.47, 1.70, 0.35], flat faces turned toward ±X so it reads clearly from the front). At the back tip a yellow disc (r 0.075, thickness 0.012, centred [0.47, 1.60, -0.48]) hangs on a wire, with a small black disc (r 0.04, centred [0.47, 1.52, -0.44]) chained from the yellow disc's lower rim — a classic Calder two-step dangler. From the front tip the black drop rod continues down to pivot3, handing off to lowerTier. All lobes are b.extrude cutouts with bevelled edges; wires in the wire colour.
parts.attaches: Beam pivots at mount pivot2 (joint arm2); its drop rod ends exactly at mount pivot3 where lowerTier's beam hangs.

parts.builds: The third balance arm, hanging from pivot3, carrying the model's hero shape. A black rod (r 0.011) runs along X from left tip [-0.38, 1.56, 0.62] (higher) to right tip [0.87, 1.47, 0.62] (lower). From the left tip a wire (r 0.008) drops 0.28 m to the biggest shape of the mobile: a black gong disc (r 0.17, thickness 0.014, centred [-0.38, 1.16, 0.62]) with a small red disc (r 0.05, thickness 0.014) seated on its front face as a centre boss. Mid-beam at [0.17, 1.50, 0.62] a wire drops to a red petal (~0.18 tall × 0.11 wide, thickness 0.012, centred [0.17, 1.30, 0.62]). From the right tip a short black drop rod (r 0.009) continues down to pendantTop. The gong is a b.extrude disc or b.lathe with a slightly irregular hand-cut rim; the petal is an organic extrude.
parts.attaches: Beam pivots at mount pivot3 (joint arm3); its drop rod ends exactly at mount pendantTop where the pendant hangs.

parts.builds: The final dangler hanging from pendantTop, the lowest and lightest element. A thin black wire (r 0.007) descends in three short drops, each ending in a flat sheet shape centred on x 0.87, z 0.62: a red oval (~0.14 tall, thickness 0.012, centred [0.87, 1.28, 0.62]), then a yellow blade (~0.16 tall, thickness 0.012, tilted about 15°, centred [0.87, 1.06, 0.62]), then a black disc (r 0.045, centred [0.87, 0.86, 0.62]) — the lowest point of the whole model at y ≈ 0.82. Wires are short (0.08–0.12 m) so the shapes stack close and read as one falling strand. Each shape is a b.extrude cutout with bevelled edges; wire drops in the wire colour.
parts.attaches: Hangs from mount pendantTop (joint pendant), the end of lowerTier's drop rod; nothing else touches it.
